# COUNTY 67 — Android Final Source Build 1.0.0

A self-contained, offline, fictional Northern Ireland-inspired open-world crime/action game prototype designed for Android/WebView. No external runtime assets or network connection are required.

## Included gameplay
- Large streamed-style 8000×8000 county map
- Towns, estates, industrial zones, farms, lake and country roads
- Third-person-style top-down camera presentation with dynamic zoom
- On-foot movement, sprinting, shooting and melee
- Driveable vehicles, traffic, collisions, vehicle health and tuning
- Police wanted system and pursuit behaviour
- Three fictional gangs with territory/reputation
- Main story missions, side jobs and random encounters
- Money, ammo, medkits, weapons, property and garage progression
- Shops, safehouses, garage, warehouse and motel
- Day/night cycle and weather states
- Minimap, GPS route, mission tracker and HUD
- Save/load, autosave, pause/settings panel
- Android touch controls plus keyboard/controller-style fallback
- Procedural original visuals and WebAudio-generated sound effects

## Build
Open the `county_67` folder in Android Studio with an installed Android SDK. The container used to produce this source package did not have the Android Gradle toolchain installed, so this package is source-ready rather than a falsely-labelled precompiled APK.

## Fiction/IP
The world is fictional and uses original names, characters, factions and procedural visuals. It is inspired by regional atmosphere rather than reproducing real businesses, people or copyrighted game assets.
